Model: Dell U2723QE
MCCS version: 2.2
VCP Features:
   Feature: 10 (Brightness)
   Feature: 12 (Contrast)
   Feature: 14 (Select color preset)
      Values:
         01: sRGB
         04: 5000K
         05: 6500K
         06: 7500K
         0b: User 1
   Feature: 60 (Input Source)
      Values:
         0f: DisplayPort-1
         11: HDMI-1
         1b: USB-C
   Feature: 62 (Audio speaker volume)
   Feature: D6 (Power mode)
      Values:
         01: DPM: On,  DPMS: Off
         02: DPM: Off, DPMS: Standby
         04: DPM: Off, DPMS: Off
